'''Adapted Viscera''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Adapted Parasites|Adapted]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==

* Spawns after a [[Primitive Viscera]] accumulates a killcount of 30 and evolves.
* Spawns in groups of 2 to 3, if [[Ubiquitous Development]] is Level 3 or higher, with spawnweight of 15.
* Spawns inside the Parasite Biome, with spawnweight of 10.

== ''Behavior'' ==

* Adapted Viscera can perform short leaps to a side of a target.
* Adapted Viscera can rally nearby [[Rupter|Rupters]] to their side, which will follow the Viscera in a group.
** Rupters that have been "bonded" to a Viscera, similarly to [[Summoner (Disambiguation)|Summoners]], will try to remain close if not attacking.
* Adapted Viscera can sink in liquids to pursue targets.
* Adapted Viscera can break blocks with [[Hardness (Disambiguation)|Hardness]] Value up to 3, with a range of 2-block range and 20 tick cooldown.
* Adapted Viscera have a chance to block your hit, nullifying it.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
Adapted Viscera, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===
* On death, Adapted Viscera have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Adapted Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
** If at least one [[Colony]] exists in the dimension, Adapted Viscera will become [[Primitive Viscera]] upon death instead.

== ''Trivia'' ==

* The Viscera was proposed on Trello by user Cephelo. The original proposal is linked [https://trello.com/c/8Sv74PaC/206-viscera here]. 
* The name of the material dropped by Adapted Viscera, [[Chipped Motherly Membrane]], seems to imply that [[Viscera (Disambiguation)|Viscera]] fulfill the role of females among the Parasites.
